subject: test(gdn): preserve shortened-query rollback and storage guards
requirement: Preserve bitwise full-width-prefix equivalence for 24 native BF16 GDN rollback/continuation cases on XPU. The test checks both reorder modes and geometries including K16/V48/D128. Unscheduled outputs, unused rollback slots and interleaved adjacent convolution layers must stay intact. The final old stack retains this one test-only change.
upstream_coverage: At 6a1ec18, upstream #600 da16a5595c105605bcd44b558c7933b934a05f85 already traverses actual ragged tokens with query_start_loc and uses the full row width for rollback capacity. The old release-branch equivalent was f4b729ae7fb3eb22c564606ec8b4d184c7c8bc4a. tests/gdn_attn/test_gdn_attn.py::test_gdn_attention_mtp_ragged and test_gdn_attention_mtp_ragged_state_reuse cover numerical accuracy and particular state-reuse cases. They leave the fork’s bitwise comparison to full-width execution, stride guards and every accepted continuation-prefix combination uncovered.

Target #660 b73bdc317dd9f38f905a866e579855cec8459a08 reserves state slot 0. csrc/xpu/gdn_attn/gated_delta_rule.hpp checks initial and final speculative state indices <=0. gdn_attn_interface.cpp passes the null id for convolution. Upstream updated the existing helper in tests/gdn_attn/test_gdn_attn_padded.py to draw positive physical IDs. The fork test uses randperm(total), including 0 as a live slot. A clean textual replay masks this invalid test setup.
The v0.34 vllm/_xpu_ops.py adapter still calls torch.ops._xpu_C.gdn_attention. The separate RecoverSSM operator and its tests do not replace this ordinary speculative call.
minimum_residual: Retain the parametrized test, allocate total+1 physical slots in both conv_storage and ssm, assign permuted real slots 1 through total and assert physical slot zero stays unchanged in both banks after each stage. Keep logical input indices and output/padding lengths unchanged. Preserve exact comparisons and keep upstream production traversal.
dependencies: Requires upstream ordinary ragged traversal #600. Parent d8e1f69699496beeda61da9a544f49d9b6378d73 intentionally changes ordinary mixed scheduling and has no invocation in these pure-spec cases.
vLLM f057cf93b0a2f797d6b23164359fda2f0624f8d5 preserves the independent rollback-column width when trimming padded request rows. The test introduces no call signature or ABI change.

performed: Verified the assigned patch changes only the padded test and its file is identical at commit and final old tip. Inspected matching target traversal, null-slot checks and upstream test assertions.
required: Run all 24 adapted test_gdn_shortened_mtp_preserves_rollback cases on the rebuilt paired B70 candidate plus upstream test_gdn_attention_mtp_ragged, test_gdn_attention_mtp_ragged_state_reuse and null-row checks.
